Four merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a `doFilterInternal` line under `web/src/main/java`. All four are squash commits on `master`, up to the head `5eb8cba` (#6674):

1. **#6673** (TRUNK-6824), merged 2026-10-12: adds `RepeatedSlashFilter`, whose `doFilterInternal` is added in the new file `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/RepeatedSlashFilter.java:50`. Commit `085d24ca`.
2. **#6680** (TRUNK-6826), merged 2026-10-13: adds `TrailingSlashFilter`, whose `doFilterInternal` is added at `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/TrailingSlashFilter.java:54`. Commit `2d32d209`.
3. **#6544** (TRUNK-6799), merged 2026-10-08: adds `OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter`, whose `doFilterInternal` is added at `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/security/OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.java:54`. Commit `a69b14a8`.
4. **#6505** (TRUNK-6705), merged 2026-08-26: changes the `doFilterInternal` signature of `GZIPFilter`, removing the old line and adding a new one at `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/GZIPFilter.java:48`. Commit `1d0fb138`.

Merge dates are the commit timestamps on `master`; I did not check GitHub's own merged-at field.

Checked and excluded: #6555 (`OpenmrsFilter`) changed its body but no line containing `doFilterInternal`. #6434, #6329, #6333 and #6643 changed `UpdateFilter`, `InitializationFilter`, `DatabaseDetective` or `WebConfig`, with no such line. #6674, #6654 and the untagged `708c62c6` also showed no such line in the files I diffed.

Limits: I diffed only the commits that plausibly touch filter code. Eight commits in the 20-commit history were not diffed: #6655, #6598, #6219, #6349, #6335, #6145, #6150 and `04a4cea`. They are unlikely to touch these filters, but I did not confirm that.
